tecWASM_REJECTED: The escrow's WASM finish function ran and returned false (or trapped), so the EscrowFinish was rejected. The fee is charged. (WASM Devnet / SmartEscrow preview.)
tefNO_WASM: The transaction expects a WASM program (FinishFunction) on the escrow but none is present, or WASM execution is unavailable on this node. (WASM Devnet / SmartEscrow preview.)
tefWASM_FIELD_NOT_INCLUDED: A WASM-related field that the smart escrow requires (for example the data or gas fields) was not included in the transaction. (WASM Devnet / SmartEscrow preview.)
temBAD_WASM: The FinishFunction bytecode is malformed, exceeds the size limit or fails validation. Never applied, no fee. (WASM Devnet / SmartEscrow preview.)
